name: no-social-contributions
description: Use this skill for Norwegian social contributions for income year 2026: the national insurance contribution (trygdeavgift) paid by employees, pensioners and the self-employed, and the employer's national insurance contribution (arbeidsgiveravgift) and financial tax on pay. It covers membership of the National Insurance Scheme, the three contribution rates (5.1%, 7.6% and 10.8%), the NOK 99,650 lower limit and the 25% phase-in limit applied once to total personal income, sole proprietors (enkeltpersonforetak) and their calculated personal income, the seven employer zones from 14.1% to 0%, the NOK 850,000 allowance, sector rules, private households, payment dates, fines and cross-border coverage. Trigger on: trygdeavgift, arbeidsgiveravgift, national insurance Norway, NAV contributions, self-employed contributions Norway, AGA, finansskatt på lønn. Out of scope: no-employer-payroll (withholding, a-melding detail), no-income-tax (income tax and bracket tax), no-individual-residence, no-cor
